facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA is an opportunity to engage with the existing Erasmus+ mobility programme for all staff who teach in Irish higher education. Staff undertaking training in the development of pedagogical and curriculum design skills can apply for a DELTA Scholarship, with further information available.
Disciplinary Excellence in Learning, Teaching and Assessment
supporting the professional development of all staff who teach in Irish higher education, with a particular focus on the enhancement of teaching and learning within and between disciplines.
This initiative is the result of a partnership between the National Forum and the Higher Education Authority, building on the success of the existing Erasmus+ mobility programme.
